changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Asset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Asset]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_ObjectId] DEFAULT (NEXT VALUE FOR [dbo].[Asset_ObjectID_Seq]) NOT NULL, [SourceID] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [KeyHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Code] [nvarchar](250) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Asset] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [UC_Asset_Object_ObjectID] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Asset_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Asset_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Asset_AssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_Asset') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_Asset] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC, [State] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [ID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetType_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetType_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ObjectID],[SourceID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetType_KeyHash_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetType_KeyHash_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC, [KeyHash] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID],[Object],[ObjectID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_Object_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_Object_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [Object] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID],[AssetTypeID],[ObjectID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_Object_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_Object_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID],[AssetTypeID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_SourceID_Object_ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_SourceID_Object_ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [SourceID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_State_AssetTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_State_AssetTypeID] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [State] ASC, [AssetTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID],[ObjectID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_uid] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [uid] ASC ) END

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Asset_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Asset] AFTER DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) select 'Delete', Object, ObjectID, ID from deleted;

changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Asset_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Asset] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID], [Custom], AssetID) select 'Add', I.Object, I.ObjectID, [queue].WriteIndexXml('', I.[Object], I.ObjectID, coalesce(I.CreatedBy, 0)), I.ID from inserted I where I.Object in('Group');
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID], [Custom], AssetID) select 'Add', I.Object, I.ObjectID, [queue].WriteIndexXml('', I.[Object], I.ObjectID, coalesce(I.CreatedBy, 0)), I.ID from inserted I where I.AssetTypeID in(select id from assettype att where not exists (select 1 from fieldtype ft where ft.AssetTypeID = att.id) and att.Class = 9) GO
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Asset_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Asset] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID], [Custom], AssetID) select 'Add', I.Object, I.ObjectID, [queue].WriteIndexXml('', I.[Object], I.ObjectID, coalesce(I.CreatedBy, 0)), I.ID from inserted I where I.Object in('Group'); GO
